main.description: Lists pending requests to join a community that requires approval.

community.description: The community to list applications for.

includeDismissed.description: Whether to include applications a moderator has hidden from the active queue.

limit.description: Maximum number of applications to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
Pagination cursor for the next page, if more applications exist.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the approval.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.
